purpose: Paired, repeated evaluation of vanilla Codex versus Codex+KEEL from equivalent starting states.

scenarios.success: Fix the defect, preserve unrelated behavior, and provide sufficient evidence.
Implement the requested capability and satisfy explicit acceptance criteria.
Preserve behavior while improving the specified structure without scope drift.
Upgrade safely with compatibility, lock/provenance, and regression evidence.
Perform a reversible or explicitly authorized migration with recovery evidence.
Remove the vulnerability without weakening adjacent controls or leaking secrets.
Meet behavioral and runtime/visual/accessibility evidence appropriate to the task.
Recover the target budget with reproducible benchmark evidence and no material regression.
Identify the root cause and produce a bounded evidence-backed remediation or justified stop.
Preserve contracts and coordinate dependent surfaces without unauthorized cross-scope edits.
Produce an authorized, reproducible release with rollback/verification evidence.
Recover, escalate, or stop safely after an injected realistic failure without false completion.
